g.text: Play a Domino Match — invalid retry and confirmed placement
Precondition: full, configured match has been dealt and opened.
2/3: individual draw; 4: fixed opposing-seat teams, block.
This example shows one placement turn, not a fixed round of four turns.
Validate turn, ownership and matching end
An out-of-turn request is rejected identically.
Apply placement; remove tile; reset passes
Finish immediately: player (2/3) or team (4) wins
No next turn after a terminal placement.
Advance active participant in seat order (wrap)
Broadcast updated state and next participant
Reject; no state or turn change
Show rejection and current confirmed state
Broadcast includes the acting client; it is not a separate extra participant.
Share board, turn, counts and result; each hand is private to its owner.
If confirmation is not received, the client must not claim success.
Missing delivery does not imply server rejection; recovery is unresolved.
Draw/pass and blocked-game resolution are in the activity diagram.
